title.zh: DeepSeek开源内部推理引擎DeepInfer：支持昇腾950，但还不是完整的在线服务
title.en: DeepSeek开源内部推理引擎DeepInfer：支持昇腾950，但还不是完整的在线服务

current_state.zh: DeepSeek open-sourced DeepInfer, its Apache 2.0 inference framework used for DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, supporting Nvidia SM100 and Huawei Ascend 950 but currently limited to offline inference with key serving components still missing.
